2.  **Delivers within 7 days**
3.  **Rated at least 6 out of 10**

*   **Orlmere Traders:** Quote 195 (Fail), Delivery 11 days (Fail), Rating 3 (Fail).
*   **Holmore Cooperative:** Quote 105 (Pass), Delivery 5 days (Pass), Rating 8 (Pass).
*   **Orlcroft Traders:** Quote 70 (Pass), Delivery 13 days (Fail), Rating 7 (Pass).
*   **Gardale Cooperative:** Quote 135 (Fail), Delivery 20 days (Fail), Rating 4 (Fail).

The only supplier meeting all criteria is Holmore Cooperative.
